preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of permutations in each test case is between 1 and 50,000.
The length of each permutation is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a_i[j] <= m for all i, j
preconditions.description: Each permutation contains distinct integers from 1 to m.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases doesn't exceed 5 * 10^4
preconditions.description: The total number of permutations across all test cases is at most 50,000.

postconditions.expression: output[i] is the largest beauty of a permutation a_i * a_j for all j
postconditions.description: For each permutation a_i, the output should list the maximum beauty of the product permutation with any other permutation a_j.
